Name: (JA) Katanas Armory
Author: WarshipGuy
Description:
[size=5][img]https://i.imgur.com/UrAU03p.png[/img][b]Overwiev[/b][/size]
Katanas Armory is combat-focused mod that adds new weapons to the game. Katanas have high speed and deal more damage than normal swords to make them a viable alternative of clubs.


[b][size=5]To Players[/size][/b]
This mod is in early stage of development, if you have any ideas on new weapons or balancing existing ones, please share them in the disscusion tab. If You discover a bug, please report it in the bugs tab. Any feedback will be appreciated and will help with creating content in the future.
